buildCommand: cd ../.. && mkdir -p apps/web/public && set +e; corepack pnpm --filter @hnk/mobile typecheck > apps/web/public/mobile-typecheck.txt 2>&1; TYPECHECK_EXIT=$?; printf '%s\n' "$TYPECHECK_EXIT" > apps/web/public/mobile-typecheck-exit.txt; set -e; cd apps/web && corepack pnpm exec next build --webpack
